description:
# Niconico YT Integration Test 1.49.0-niconico.3

Personal test build in david419kr's fork. No upstream PR has been opened.

## Fixes
- Drop live-chat batches while playback is paused or the full player is inactive, checking again before updating the view.
- Bound retained live comments to 512. Replay lookahead is preserved because its continuation has already advanced.
- Keep currently needed and in-flight emoji entries from being evicted into repeated download requests.
- Bound the shared image worker pool to two active workers and 32 queued loads; retain at most 128 image entries.
- Prefetch only visible/near-future emoji and ignore stale image results after a video change. Over-budget images use a placeholder instead of growing the work queue.

## Validation
- 166 unit tests passed, including 34 Niconico tests; five upstream Music APK-fixture tests were skipped.
- Frozen-clock 10,000-message regression stays within the 512-live-comment bound without discarding replay lookahead.
- 129 active image URLs over 60 passes do not repeatedly schedule downloads; in-flight protection, stale results, rejection recovery, and queue saturation are tested.
- Built the Android MPP and applied all 107 selected patches to original YouTube 21.23.492; rebuilding succeeded with zero failed patches.
- This release has not yet had device stress testing. The previous .2 build was reported working on a phone.

Declared Niconico compatibility remains YouTube 21.20.405 and 21.23.492. 21.04.223 has not been added.

## 폰에서 업데이트
1. **Sources → Niconico YT Integration Test → Update**에서 **1.49.0-niconico.3**을 확인합니다.
2. 기존 원격 주소는 그대로입니다: `https://github.com/david419kr/morphe-patches`.
3. 다른 공식/독립 니코니코 소스를 비활성화한 상태에서, 원본 **21.23.492 APK**에 권장 패치와 니코니코 패치를 다시 적용하고 설치합니다.
4. 활발한 라이브 채팅에서 일시정지 후 재개, 플레이어 최소화 후 복귀, 다양한 이모지 표시, 리플레이와 탐색 동작을 확인합니다.

The upstream PR-preparation branch and the personal test branch both contain the fixes. The standalone 1.3.3 source is unchanged.
